answer: Issue the same unannounced task to random pairs of agents. A farm's copies all run one kernel of instructions, so their answers arrive identical, while honest agents diverge in detail. When two answers collide word-for-word, both identities are burned: the operator's own coordination becomes the tripwire. One saffron thread of shared script is enough to condemn the whole batch, and the farm's nadir is that it cannot fake divergence without paying a human to write each copy separately.
